subject.title: feat(sessions): upstream liveness for adopted catalog sessions

question: Should adopted-session liveness become a stable public SessionCatalogProvider SDK capability now, and if so must source identity and provider parsing remain fully plugin-defined?
rationale: The branch expands a third-party Plugin SDK surface, but the current shape hardcodes bundled provider identities and promotes Claude-specific policy into core; choosing the permanent contract is a maintainer-owned compatibility decision.

options.title: Define a generic plugin-owned seam
options.body: Keep core limited to opaque provider-owned link identity and generic activity results, with all Claude/Codex source parsing and pagination inside the owning plugins.

options.title: Keep the seam bundled-only
options.body: Avoid public SDK exports for this iteration and use an internal bundled-plugin capability until another external consumer proves the stable contract.

options.title: Pause for SessionObserver design
options.body: Defer this PR and resolve the broader observer registry and subscription model in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/104804 first.

recommendation.title: Define a generic plugin-owned seam
recommendation.body: Keep core limited to opaque provider-owned link identity and generic activity results, with all Claude/Codex source parsing and pagination inside the owning plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged session-awareness work and current feature-history ownership make them the best available decision owner for the SDK boundary.
